generator.why: Q, K, V and dO within ±3, so scores stay in the tens. The numpy generator draws up to ±30: scores reach the hundreds, softmax becomes a hard argmax, and float32 rounding flips near-ties. Stored cases keep the full range.

skip.gen-1-1: A baked draw from the numpy generator's full range: its attention scores reach the hundreds, and two keys within float32 rounding of each other decide the answer, so two correct float32 solutions disagree. The twin's own generator draws float32-scale inputs instead.
